messages:
rhea_sales: Skyline follow-up  asking for a 6-month dedicated commit with autoscale + mixed GPU pool (A100 + L40). They want a capped burst spend during the POC.

sam_se: We usually do vGPU-hour pricing and a blended rate for mixed pools. Can provide line items for each GPU type.

tara_finance: What's the requested discount? For POC we can consider up to 18% on baseline commit if we include prepaid burst credits.

rhea_sales: Customer requested 15% on baseline and a $/day cap on burst consumption. Prefer 200 GPU-hrs of prepaid burst credits that can be used across GPUs.

leo_eng: Notes: autoscale will pull L40s for peak throughput; caching cuts token cost but not GPU-hours. Region eu-west needs reserved capacity to guarantee burst latency. Ops lead time ~12 days.
sam_se: Blended calc example: A100 $4/hr, L40 $2.5/hr, mix 55/45 -> blended $3.475/hr, with 15% -> $2.95/hr. I'll add both per-GPU and blended rows on the quote.

tara_finance: Approving 15% commit discount + 200 prepaid burst credits at blended rate, conditional: if burst usage > 4x baseline for 2 months straight, 10% true-up applies next term. No rollover for unused prepaid credits. Deal Desk sign-off required.

infra_bot: quote-bot: Draft quote Q-2098 created (6mo commit, 2k vGPU-hrs/mo baseline, 200 prepaid burst credits).

rhea_sales: Thx bot. @tara_finance please escalate Deal Desk approval for capped-burst credits and mixed-pool pricing. I'll confirm POC start date with customer and offer staged start if reserved nodes aren't ready.

leo_eng: I'll attach KMS/audit checklist for Dedicated and the region capacity note to the deal doc.
tara_finance: Escalated. Once Deal Desk confirms, I'll update contract terms and send to legal.
rhea_sales: Sending updated quote to Skyline now. Kickoff tentatively set for 2026-06-02. :rocket:
